samples.xml_description:
<module id="pe">
    <description>Implement a Multiplying Accumulator for 32bit integer.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset.</input>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand B.</input>
        <output id="c" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit output representing the accumulated result.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="PE">The parameter PE represents the number of processing elements.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="c" width_description="[31:0]">Accumulator register to store the accumulated result.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <![CDATA[
            The module implements a parallel multiplier and accumulator using registers and an always block.
            It multiplies the input operands and accumulates the result into an output register.
            Accumulator Register:
            The module includes a register, c, to store the accumulated result.
            On the positive edge of the clock signal (clk) or the positive edge of the reset signal (rst), the module updates the register.
            If the reset signal (rst) is high, indicating a reset condition, the register (c) is set to 0.
            If the reset signal (rst) is low, the register (c) is updated by adding the product of the input operands (a and b) to its current value.
            Multiplication and Accumulation:
            Inside the always block, the module performs the multiplication and accumulation operation.
            If the reset signal (rst) is high, the register (c) is set to 0.
            If the reset signal (rst) is low, the module adds the product of the input operands (a and b) to the register (c).
        ]]>
    </implementation>
</module>
